prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1421; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across the center and the left taillight assembly is broken, with scuffing running down the left quarter panel. The pattern of damage lines up with the low-speed contact described for this parking lot incident, and nothing I found suggests older impact marks or prior repair work on this vehicle. The labor hours requested fit the replacement and refinishing needed, and the parts list contains no duplicated line items. Recommended plan: replace the bumper cover and taillight assembly, blend and refinish the quarter panel, and recheck the parking sensor wiring once the panels are off.
